integrity: Original mathematical argument and exact arithmetic supplied with explicit finite-field counterexample at the equality boundary of a published non-GRS assertion; independent validation has not occurred. Earlier general conic and longer-length non-GRS results are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns only the two three-dimensional degree-deleted evaluation families with the stated triple symmetric-function MDS condition; it does not assert anything about arbitrary MDS codes, other dimensions, or evaluation at infinity. The finite-field checker is illustrative; an all-field conic and Vieta proof is supplied. Literature coverage may be incomplete.
title: Sharp GRS recovery by puncturing two degree-deleted cubic evaluation families
